summary: Former Umpqua National Forest lookout site. An L-4 cab built in 1933 was removed or destroyed in 1966; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab (1933), on a site with a pole-frame shelter recorded from 1929
facts.status_note: The cab was removed or destroyed in 1966. No source describes what remains at the site.

access.note: On Umpqua National Forest land. No source describes current access.

visit.trail_note: No tower stands. A 1953 survey description gives the route as three hours by horse pack from Toketee Falls via the Cinder Prairie Trail.

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on 1966: the FFLOS register says removed, firelookout.com says destroyed. Both give 1966, so the year is firm, the manner is not. No source describes the site today beyond a 1953 survey description of a disk stamped 1938; whether it survives is unknown. Staffing rests on newspaper items quoted by the Forest Lookouts page; the last one found is August 1958. The 1927 and 1929 items come from the same Forest Lookouts transcription and were not checked against originals. The 1929, 1931, 1953 and 1958 dates were checked against the page on 2026-10-09. Record fields (design L-4, elevation, coordinates, status gone) match the sources; no corrections proposed.
